**MSBuild SDK-style evaluation order:**
1. `Sdk.props` → imports `Microsoft.Common.props` → which imports `Directory.Build.props`
2. Wildcard before/after props imports (around Directory.Build.props)
3. Project file body

5. NuGet `.g.targets`

Here are the bugs I found in `hard/`:

---

**Bug 1 – Parent `Directory.Build.props` never chained.** MSBuild stops at the first `Directory.Build.props` it finds. `hard/Directory.Build.props` exists, so the root one (which sets `RepoRoot`) is never imported.

**Bug 2 – `Common.props` condition is backwards.** The condition checks `'$(CommonPropsImported)' == 'true'`, but `CommonPropsImported` is *set inside* `Common.props`. It's a chicken-and-egg — the file that defines the flag is gated on the flag already being true. Should be `!= 'true'` (guard against double-import) or removed.

**Bug 3 – `CustomBeforeMicrosoftCommonTargets` set too late.** Both `Directory.Build.targets` files set this property, but `Microsoft.Common.targets` reads it *before* importing `Directory.Build.targets`. The property must be set in `Directory.Build.props` to take effect. This is why the pre-build hook is silently dropped.

**Bug 4 – `GenerateAssemblyInfo` target name collision.** The SDK has a built-in target named `GenerateAssemblyInfo` (from `Microsoft.NET.GenerateAssemblyInfo.targets`). The custom target silently *replaces* it, breaking SDK assembly-info generation.

**Bug 5 – Unconditional imports of missing files.** Root `Directory.Build.targets` imports `$(RepoRoot)eng\custom-analyzers.props` unconditionally. `hard/Directory.Build.targets` imports `$(RepoToolsPath)\code-analysis.targets` — but `RepoToolsPath` depends on `Common.props` which is never imported (Bug 2). **Bug 6 – `ImportByWildcardBeforeMicrosoftCommonProps` set too late.** The "before" wildcard imports happen *before* `Directory.Build.props` is imported, so setting it to `false` there has no effect on the "before" imports.

| 5 | **Parent props not inherited** | `hard/Directory.Build.props` shadows root — MSBuild stops at first found | Added `GetPathOfFileAbove` to chain to parent |
| 6 | **`ImportByWildcardBefore*` ineffective** | Set in `Directory.Build.props` but "before" wildcards run earlier | Removed the ineffective setting; kept only `AfterMicrosoftCommonProps` which *can* be controlled from here |
